parameters.command:
try {
  $cpu = (Get-WmiObject Win32_Processor | Measure-Object -Property LoadPercentage -Average).Average
  $os = Get-WmiObject Win32_OperatingSystem
  $memTotal = [math]::Round($os.TotalVisibleMemorySize / 1024 / 1024, 2)
  $memFree = [math]::Round($os.FreePhysicalMemory / 1024 / 1024, 2)
  $memUsed = [math]::Max(0, [math]::Round($memTotal - $memFree, 2))
  $disk = Get-WmiObject Win32_LogicalDisk -Filter "DeviceID='C:'"
  $diskTotal = [math]::Round($disk.Size / 1073741824, 2)
  $diskFree = [math]::Round($disk.FreeSpace / 1073741824, 2)
  $diskUsed = [math]::Max(0, [math]::Round($diskTotal - $diskFree, 2))

  $statsLogPath = "C:\\Program Files\\FileMaker\\FileMaker Server\\Logs\\Stats.log"
  $topCallPath = "C:\\Program Files\\FileMaker\\FileMaker Server\\Logs\\TopCallStats.log"

  $statsLine = ""
  if (Test-Path $statsLogPath) {
      $statsLine = (Get-Content -Path $statsLogPath -Tail 1)
  }
  $topLine = ""
  if (Test-Path $topCallPath) {
      $topLine = (Get-Content -Path $topCallPath -Tail 1)
  }

  $obj = @{
      cpu = $cpu
      memTotal = $memTotal
      memUsed = $memUsed
      diskTotal = $diskTotal
      diskUsed = $diskUsed
      diskFree = $diskFree
      statsLine = $statsLine
      topLine = $topLine
  }
  $obj | ConvertTo-Json -Compress
} catch {
  Write-Output "{\"error\": \"$($_.Exception.Message)\"}"
}
